Docket 1.3.155

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Reports say when Core Web Vitals field values were read.* When PageSpeed Insights returned field data from real Chrome users,
  the report's scope note still said Google had no field data for the site. It now says the values were read, and still says so
  plainly when Google has none or was not asked.
- *A licence key saved with `docket licence --key` keeps its activation.* If the same key had first been given in a setting, such
  as the Claude Desktop extension's, saving it could leave its activation record behind, and the next check could use another of
  your activations. The record now moves with the key.
- *Very large shops audit without running out of memory.* The check for pages competing for the same search compared every
  product page with every other before setting product pairs aside. With thousands of similar product titles that alone could
  exhaust memory. Product pairs are now never built. Results are unchanged.
- *AI assistants keep local sites apart.* In the MCP server, kept audits of different local sites, such as two ports on
  localhost, were treated as one site, so "the latest report" or a comparison could mix them up.
- *Two more AI crawlers.* ShapBot and Shap-User, from Parallel Web Systems, are now checked in your robots.txt with the others.

99 checks across 13 areas.
